dense_label: memory/cache pressure, not guaranteed cache flush

states.DENSE_MEMORY_PRESSURE: same 256MiB allocation, full read, pressure outside target range/timing; not claimed cache flush
states.SPARSE_PAGE_PRESSURE: same 256MiB allocation, 4096-byte stride, pressure outside target range/timing
states.WARM_A: two target warmups, sync, target-only timing/profile
states.WARM_B: two target warmups after DENSE, sync, target-only timing
